name: Greencycled Sipper
shortStory: Give discarded wine bottles a second life. The Greencycled Sipper is a 500 ml upcycled glass tumbler designed for everyday hydration. Complete with a PLA-based bioplastic lid, stainless steel straw and cleaning brush, it's a functional choice for more conscious living.
description: Give discarded wine bottles a second life. The Greencycled Sipper is a 500 ml upcycled glass tumbler designed for everyday hydration. Complete with a PLA-based bioplastic lid, stainless steel straw and cleaning brush, it's a functional choice for more conscious living.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Category: Kitchenware
• Capacity: 500 ml
• Net Weight: 415 g
• Dimensions: 9.5 × 9.5 × 22 cm
• What's Included: Upcycled Glass Sipper, PLA-Based Bioplastic Lid, Stainless Steel Straw and Straw Cleaning Brush
• Reusable: Yes
• Suitable For: Normal to cold beverages, including water, juices, shakes and smoothies. Not suitable for hot beverages.
• Natural Variations: Crafted from upcycled wine bottles. Slight variations in shape, colour and finish are natural. Shades of green may vary depending on bottle availability.
• Bulk Orders & Customisation: Available for orders of 50 pieces or more. Personalisation with a logo or name in simple fonts is available on request.
• Ships from Goa within 2-3 working days, thoughtfully packed in recycled cardboard packaging.

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Upcycled Glass Sipper: Dishwasher-safe with a gentle detergent. Handle with care and avoid impact or sudden temperature changes.
• Bioplastic Lid & Stainless Steel Straw: Hand wash with mild dishwashing liquid and a soft sponge or scrubber.
• Straw Cleaning Brush: Rinse thoroughly after use and allow to air-dry.
